hypothesis: The PMU measurement region meets its instruction, register-access, lock and memory budgets under instruction emulation and QEMU Cortex-A55 and Cortex-A76 models.
prediction: Budgets (baseline -> budget, measured by). Instructions retired in an empty region (begin's counter writes to end's counter reads): none for this module, the fixture's inline ISB, MRS pair is about 2 (counted) -> at most 24 on the A55 and A76 models (QEMU -icount shift=0, INST_RETIRED of back-to-back begin and end on each core). System-register accesses per begin and end, configured path: the a733_cpu_cycles_sample pair does 22 accesses and 2 ISB for the cycle counter alone (counted) -> at most 28 accesses and 2 ISB, with no configuration readback, CurrentEL, DSB, DMB or SVC (Unicorn access log in checks/cpu-pmu.py; QEMU -d in_asm trace). Locks, allocations, MMIO, wake-ups per region: one kernel critical section in begin's vTaskCoreAffinityGet, before the counted window, otherwise zero (Unicorn memory log: only the stack, the record and the core's own state line). Lines written by more than one core: zero (Unicorn address log; static assertion of 64-byte alignment). Memory: record 64 B, state 8 x 64 B, region at most 32 B (static assertions; nm sizes). Empty-region cycles on cores 0 and 6: not measured -> provisional at most 150 on the A55 and 100 on the A76 (estimated; board session). Reasoning: a region has no interrupt or wake-up (section 2 item 1 does not apply because the module waits for nothing); an event counting four per cycle at 2 GHz (estimated) needs about 0.5 s to overflow 2^32.

conditions.kind: Unicorn instruction emulation and QEMU 10.2.1; no board
conditions.base: merge base with the integration branch, 14c3cd8cd27ca4da69a986c222ef691e319aff4e, extracted with git archive
conditions.measured: commit 1aa1493 (adds the module and its checks); measured images built from the worktree whose header matched that commit; each tree configured and built in its own directory with clang 21 and the project toolchain file
conditions.base_mechanisms: the base tree has no region module; comparable mechanisms are the inline ISB, MRS PMEVCNTR0_EL0 pair that QEMU fixtures use and the pair of a733_cpu_cycles_sample calls; a bare-metal EL1 program built from the base tree measured both under QEMU 10.2.1 (virt, -icount shift=0, -cpu cortex-a55 and -cpu cortex-a76) with counter 0 counting INST_RETIRED; the access count of the sample pair comes from the base tree's checks/cpu-clock-check.py instruction model; the base harness needs -mstrict-align because its output buffer is written with unaligned stores while the MMU is off
conditions.module_checks: checks/cpu-pmu.py (Unicorn, board SMP flags with -mgeneral-regs-only, eight-core configuration) and checks/cpu-pmu-smp.py (QEMU 10.2.1, two cores, the FreeRTOS SMP port at EL1, -icount shift=0); QEMU counts instructions exactly and its cycle counter follows virtual time and says nothing about A733 cycles

conclusion: Every budget is met. checks/cpu-pmu-smp.py passes on both CPU models; checks/cpu-pmu.py passes its 20 module cases and verifies three pinned sources, then failed on the continuation sources at measurement time, as the design required until both continuation paths copy PMCR_EL0.N into MDCR_EL2.HPMN (both continue.S files now do, and checks/a733-cpu-continue.py expects mdcr_el2 = 6); checks/cpu-clock-check.py passes unchanged. QEMU implements INST_RETIRED and none of the other five events, so the supported mask is 0x1 on both models; the instruction model covers the other events with modeled PMCEID bits. The new header joined the header globs that seven image identities hash: sunstone-a733-storage-maintenance, -smp-cached-devices, -board, -camera, -gpu-render, -hdmi and -mimus-native were built from both trees, and in each every differing byte lies in the 32-byte a733_smp_build_id; code and data are otherwise identical; no image linked the module. A second independent run built the base tree and commit bdce0fa (documentation-only change after 1aa1493) from git archive exports in separate directories and reproduced every figure (base harness under QEMU 4 and 64 instructions on both models, base Unicorn count 22 accesses, 2 ISB, 56 instructions, the 224-byte base object, the module's 14 + 14 accesses and 70 / 95 instructions, the 1,488-byte module code, the 512-byte state, and 20 instructions per empty region on both cores of both QEMU models); the -board, -smp-cached-devices and -storage-maintenance images again differed only inside a733_smp_build_id.
narrative: Results table (metric: base / measured / budget). Instructions in an empty region, QEMU A55 / A76, cores 0 and 1: inline ISB, MRS pair 4 / 4; measured 20 / 20 on both cores; budget at most 24. Loop of 2,000 instructions, counted above the empty loop region: measured 2,000 on both cores and both models; exact. System-register accesses, begin + end, configured path (MSR DAIFSet included): sample pair 22, cycle counter only; measured 14 + 14 = 28, six event counters and the cycle counter; at most 28. ISB per begin + end: 2; 1 + 1; at most 2. DSB, DMB, SVC, CurrentEL reads, configuration readbacks per region: CurrentEL read twice and three configuration reads per sample; 0; 0. Locks per region: 0; one kernel critical section in vTaskCoreAffinityGet before the counted window. Allocations, MMIO, wake-ups: 0. Memory touched per call: stack, region, record, the core's own state line. Lines written by more than one core: 0. Record / state / region size: 64 B / 8 x 64 B, 64-byte aligned / 24 B against 64 B / 512 B / at most 32 B. Instructions per call in Unicorn, configured path, begin / end: 56 for the sample pair; 70 (stub affinity call included) / 95. Module code (.text, four functions): 224 B (a733_cpu_cycles_native.o) base; 1,488 B. The base pair of a733_cpu_cycles_sample calls counts 64 instructions between two inline counter reads on both QEMU models, one inline read included; it reads only the cycle counter and checks the cycle configuration and CurrentEL on every call, where the module checks the enable bit once per region and reads six event counters as well. Evidence directory ~/.cache/sunstoneos/evidence/cpu-pmu-20261022/: baseline.json, baseline-qemu.log, baseline-unicorn.json and baseline-harness/ (base-tree measurements and the program that made them); host/results.json and host.stdout (checks/cpu-pmu.py with access counts, object hash, section sizes, pinned and unfetched sources and the continuation failures); smp/result.json and per-model logs (checks/cpu-pmu-smp.py); cpu-clock-check/ (the unchanged CPU clock check); image-comparison.txt (byte comparison of the seven images). Pinned sources of the register sequence: Cortex-A55 TRM 100442_0200_00 (r2p0) at ~/.cache/sunstoneos/sources/cpu-continue/cortex-a55-trm.pdf, SHA-256 1f71b74d5cf1cbf3c86dab85d1407c45355ab5015d12d68afc0dc64107f7dd97; TF-A 0892ad4d include/arch/aarch64/arch.h under cpu-entry/; the vendor EL3 monitor monitor.fex from orangepi-build a95129bf with disassembly in cpu-startup/monitor.disasm. checks/cpu-pmu-sources.json pins the A55 TRM, TF-A arch.h and the monitor disassembly with hashes the host check verifies, and lists DDI 0487 and the A76 TRM (100798, r4p1) with URLs and no hash (fetching needs the user's approval; the host check reports them as not fetched). Not proven by a pinned source: A76 event numbers and counter count; ISB placement around counter reads, direct counter access, and MDCR_EL2.HPMN = 0 behavior on Armv8.2 cores (Arm DDI 0487, not pinned); whether time in the EL3 monitor counts in the event counters (MDCR_EL3.SPME is 0, so Secure event counting depends on the SoC's debug authentication signals; regions exclude SMC calls). EL2/EL3 controls: both continuation paths write MDCR_EL3 = 0x10000000 (MDCR_MTPME_BIT, MDCR_EL3_RESET_VAL in TF-A arch.h line 796); TPM (bit 6) is 0 and SCR_EL3 = 0x535 makes EL1 Non-secure. MDCR_EL2 was written as zero at platform/a733/cpu_continue.S line 92 and platform/a733-smp-cached/continue.S line 103 (HPMN bits 4:0, TF-A arch.h line 816, zero: EL1 owns no event counter and HPMN = 0 is CONSTRAINED UNPREDICTABLE on Armv8.2); the vendor monitor writes PMCR_EL0.N | HPMD | HLP (monitor.disasm 0x48004880-0x48004890); the requested change reads PMCR_EL0.N at EL3 into MDCR_EL2.HPMN keeping TPM, TPMCR and HPME zero, and checks/a733-cpu-continue.py lines 196-197 expect mdcr_el2 = 6 for the modeled PMCR_EL0. Reuse: a733_cpu_cycles_enable and a733_cpu_cycles_sample have no caller outside checks/cpu-clock-check.py; the private pmu_start and pmu_read helpers in checks/memory-architecture-smp.c and checks/device-memory-capacity.c stay because their inline two-instruction read is shorter than a call. Tasks that set another's affinity: only at creation (apps/board/main.c, apps/spi/main.c) and in scheduler migration checks. Left out: sampling and PMU interrupts, EL0 access, caller-selected events, chained 64-bit event counters, the DSU cluster PMU, external debug (APB) access and multiplexing of more than six events.

hypothesis: The single-core form of the PMU region module configures on a Cortex-A55 core 0 without an exception, counts all six events, and meets the empty-region cycle budget.

conditions.regions: 64 empty regions; fixed region of 2,000 ALU instructions; 1 ms counter loop; one load per line of a cleaned and invalidated 64 KiB buffer, 1,024 lines

conclusion: PMCR_EL0 reads 0x41453041 (six event counters), PMCEID0_EL0 0x7fffffff and PMCEID1_EL0 0x01f0ae7f; all six events of the record are implemented (supported mask 0x3f) and no exception occurred. An empty region is 20 instructions in each of 64 regions, as in both QEMU models, and 64 cycles at the minimum and median, 131 at most, within the provisional 150-cycle A55 budget. 2,000 ALU instructions count 2,020, exactly 2,000 above the empty median, in 7,238 cycles. A 1 ms counter loop counts 494,104 cycles over 24,005 ticks of the 24 MHz counter: 494.0 MHz, the CPU-L rate. L2D_CACHE_REFILL is implemented on the A733's A55: 1,024 lines counted 1,031 refills. Cores 6 and 7 (Cortex-A76) have not run the module on the board.
